definitions.explanation: A pastime someone pours time and money into for pleasure rather than profit. Often said with a wry tone, as of an expensive or impractical passion.
A life given over to drinking, gambling, or womanizing; the person who lives it is a {道楽者|どうらくもの}. Somewhat old-fashioned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道楽|どうらく}だ。
examples.english: Fishing is my father's great indulgence.

examples.japanese: {食道楽|くいどうらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: He's a big foodie and spends half his salary eating out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{道楽|どうらく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}っている→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: The shop loses money, but the owner just laughs and says he runs it for fun.

examples.japanese: {道楽|どうらく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: He leads too dissolute a life.

examples.japanese: {道楽息子|どうらくむすこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{果|は}たした→使い果たす：07667_tsukaihatasu⟧。
examples.english: The prodigal son squandered the family fortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{賭|か}け{事|ごと}→賭け事：18665_kakegoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道楽|どうらく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泣|な}かせた→泣く：00655_naku⟧ものだ。
examples.english: When I was young, my drinking and gambling used to make my parents weep.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{食|く}い→食う：02657_kuu⟧{道楽|どうらく} / ⟦{食道楽|しょくどうらく}→食道楽：24352_shokudouraku⟧: a passion for good food; a gourmet
- {着道楽|きどうらく}: spending lavishly on clothes
- {道楽息子|どうらくむすこ}: a prodigal son
- {道楽|どうらく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to do something as a hobby, not for money

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧: hobby, the neutral word; {道楽|どうらく} adds the idea of indulgence or excess
- ⟦{放蕩|ほうとう}→放蕩：09468_houtou⟧: dissipation (literary), close to sense 2
